about: src/lib/reconcile_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (the backend and the POS core run the same close check from madar-till). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it, and features/tills/util.test.ts runs the close dialog's check against it.
